issue.title: Bead-assigned phase agents cannot hand off: gate-turn creation fails with missing_gate_turn_row and sase monitor start fails with NameCollisionError
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1e3.11 (release phase, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #6, plus note #5); triaged by the sase-1e3 land agent on 2026-10-01. Not caused by sase-1e3, which made no sase changes.

On 2026-10-01 around 18:18 EDT, agent sase-1e3.11 was a bead-assigned phase agent launched by `sase bead work sase-1e3`, running from a sase workspace on apollo. It needed a merge gate followed by a continuation. Both handoff mechanisms failed:

1. Gate-turn creation (a `/sase_gate` with a continuation turn) failed with `missing_gate_turn_row`. The agent fell back to a durable non-turn custom gate (custom-fbaf45ea-6d5d-414e-8841-143538e37a39, panel `releases`), so no continuation agent was attached.
2. `sase monitor start` (the gate-wait monitor follow-up) failed with `NameCollisionError` for the bead-assigned agent lane. The agent name `sase-1e3.11` appears to collide with the monitor's successor name.

Result: the phase could not hand off. Nothing verified the publish runs or PyPI after the merge, and the gap surfaced only in the next phase. The root cause is undiagnosed: the agent's transcript summary records only the error class names.

Related, possibly the same root cause:
- sase-12v: a waiter fails with NameCollisionError at wake.
- sase-161: the missing_gate_turn_row guard scope.

Investigate the following:
- Whether `create_gate_turn` or the gate-turn transaction refuses agent-originated turn blocks for bead-assigned agents.
- Whether monitor/gate successor naming reuses the reserved bead-assigned agent name.

Reproduce with a phase agent launched through `sase bead work <epic>` that runs `/sase_gate` with a turn block, then `/sase_monitor`.

task_type_fields.impact: Epic phase agents that need a human gate or a long wait cannot continue mechanically; follow-up verification is dropped and the phase closes with unverified work
task_type_fields.location: gate-turn creation path (sase.gate_turn.transaction.create_gate_turn / notification_gates validation missing_gate_turn_row) and sase monitor start successor naming for bead-assigned agent names
task_type_fields.repro: From a phase agent launched by 'sase bead work <epic>' (agent name = phase bead id), run /sase_gate with a continuation turn -> missing_gate_turn_row; then /sase_monitor start -> NameCollisionError (observed by sase-1e3.11 on apollo 2026-10-01 ~18:18 EDT)

issue.creation_reason: Release phase sase-1e3.11 could not attach a continuation to its merge gate or start a wait monitor, so post-merge publish verification silently fell through the cracks.

payload.description: Same NameCollisionError class on a successor launch for a reserved agent name
Scope of the missing_gate_turn_row guard that refused the agent's gate-turn creation

payload.entry: Root cause is _handle_gate_create in src/sase/main/gate_handler.py dispatching only on a dict shell block, so canonical turn blocks and --turn/--next* flags fell through to create_gate and hit missing_gate_turn_row; fixed to normalize via normalize_gate_spec_block and dispatch on any non-None turn with CLI regression tests in tests/gate_turn/test_gate_create_cli_turn.py (lands with this commit), using the legacy shell key as the workaround on older installs. The sase monitor start NameCollisionError half remains open and undiagnosed.
